about_the_game:
A museum and its stories… Think you know everything about them?
To truly feel history, to sense the connection between generations of life and memory, one visit won’t be enough.

Step into the Quirky Museum

This isn’t your average historical attraction. It’s a place where forgotten memories whisper through the halls, where no exhibit is ever truly still. Every object has a secret. Every guest has a reason to be here. Strange things attract stranger ones. If young restorer Henry Tate had known that, perhaps this story would never have happened.

But it’s hard to say what can or can’t happen—especially when people begin to disappear from the portraits…

  • Unravel a mysterious story with multiple paths, secrets, and surprises

  • Solve puzzles to restore exhibits

  • Search for hidden objects across richly detailed museum rooms

  • Explore a surreal world where the past comes alive—and sometimes tries to escape

The museum will open tonight. The question is: will it let you leave?
